'''Flyconid''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Flyconid}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Weakening Spores
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Applies 2 {{BD2|Vulnerable}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Vulnerable
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Frail Spores
|Intent = Attack2, Debuff
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage. Applies 2 {{BD2|Frail}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Frail
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Smash
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (11;{{Asc2|9|12}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
On its first turn, it randomly picks {{Int2|Flyconid|Frail Spores}} (2/3 chance) or {{Int2|Flyconid|Smash}} (1/3 chance).

After that, each turn it randomly picks one of three moves: {{Int2|Flyconid|Weakening Spores}} (3/6 chance), {{Int2|Flyconid|Frail Spores}} (2/6 chance), or {{Int2|Flyconid|Smash}} (1/6 chance). It cannot use the same move twice in a row.

== Notes ==
* {{Int2|Flyconid|Weakening Spores}} applies {{BD2|Vulnerable}}, causing you to take 50% more damage from attacks. This is especially dangerous when paired with other enemies.
* {{Int2|Flyconid|Frail Spores}} applies {{BD2|Frail}}, reducing your {{KW2|Block}} gained by 25%.
* Flyconid cannot open with {{Int2|Flyconid|Weakening Spores}} on the first turn.
